description: This file defines API routes for report generation and download in a FastAPI application. It includes endpoint functions for creating reports from datasets and retrieving report files, utilizing services and schemas defined elsewhere in the project.

methods.name: ReportResponse generate_report( req: ReportRequest, svc: ReportService = get_report_service, )
methods.description: API endpoint to generate a report based on input data, calling the report service to create the report and returning a response with report details.

methods.name: FileResponse download_report( report_filename: str = Query(..., description="Report filename"), svc: ReportService = get_report_service, )
methods.description: API endpoint to download a previously generated report file by filename, returning the file as a response.

ctags.signature: ( report_filename: str = Query(..., description="Report filename"), svc: ReportService = get_report_service, )
